biggest_catch: The friend must do real banking - 10 debit transactions AND $250 in direct deposits within 60 days - or neither of you earns anything.
catches: The referring member earns a $50 reward bonus per individual referred who registers, opens a new checking account, and completes the offer requirements.

Friend must register via the referral link, open a Heritage High-Yield, Loyalty Rewards, or Traditional checking account, then within 60 days: 10+ debit card transactions (no ATMs), direct deposits totaling $250+, and keep the account in good standing.
Referrer must be a primary account holder at Credit Union West, register for the program, and share the offer; max $500 in reward bonuses per calendar year (10 referrals).
Only one referrer may receive the bonus per referred person.
Bonus appears in the referrer's Membership Share account up to 60 days after the friend meets all requirements.
Bonuses are considered interest and will be reported on IRS Form 1099-MISC; offer can change at any time without notice.
Members must be 18+; $5 minimum balance for membership.
